overview.title: Accounting that's actually useful.
overview.text: From tracking your finances and uncovering growth opportunities to giving you clear, practical guidance, we're the partner in your corner so you can focus on doing what you do best—running your business.

services.title: Small Business Accounting & Bookkeeping
services.text: Stay organized and in control. We handle your monthly bookkeeping, reconciliations, financial statements and payroll, so everything stays clean, clear and ready to review.
services.lead: Marino CPA keeps the day-to-day books in order so the numbers are there when you need them, not scrambled together at year end.

covers.title: Tracking payments and receivables

covers.title: Virtual controllership

services.title: Strategic Tax Planning & Filing
services.text: Make tax season a breeze—and a smart move. We help you avoid surprises and find savings with proactive planning, and we work with you year-round, not just in April.
services.lead: Tax work at Marino CPA starts well before a return is due, because most of what changes the outcome has to be decided while the year is still open.
services.imageAlt: A calculator and firm envelopes on a desk beside a laptop

services.title: Audits & Assurance
services.text: Our audit department provides reliable, independent assurance services designed to strengthen confidence in your financial information, for local governments, nonprofits and privately held organizations.
services.lead: As a Texas-based CPA firm, we understand the regulatory environment, reporting standards and practical challenges faced by local governments, nonprofits and privately held organizations. We go beyond compliance by delivering audits that are efficient, transparent and tailored to your organization. We are committed to integrity, technical excellence and responsive service, with the goal of assurance you can rely on and insights that help your organization move forward with confidence.

covers.title: Financial statement audits, reviews and compilations
covers.text: The level of assurance matched to what your lenders, board or funders actually require.

covers.title: Governmental and single audits

questions.q: How does the audit team keep us informed?
questions.a: Our experienced professionals apply a risk-based approach and maintain open communication throughout the engagement, so you understand not only the results of the audit but the story behind the numbers.

questions.q: Who do we contact about an audit engagement?
questions.a: The audit department can be reached directly at audit@marinocpafirm.com.

about.title: We see you and we understand.
text: At Marino CPA, we don't just crunch numbers — we see you. We understand the pressures, the goals and the grit it takes to run a business. That's why we become more than your accountant — we become your ally, focused on unlocking your full potential.

At the heart of everything we do are two simple values: clear communication and personal attention. We believe accounting shouldn't be confusing—or impersonal. That's why we take the time to explain things in plain language, keep you informed at every step, and ensure you always know where you stand.

You're never just a file or a number to us. We listen, we respond, and we tailor our services to your unique needs. We have proudly served clients in the Houston and Beaumont communities for over 35 years.

We value working with people who are passionate about their business, because that passion is contagious and it attracts what the business needs. Our client relationships are collaborative, and we recognize the impact small businesses have on a community through drive, cultivation and innovation.

team.name: Jeff Marino, CPA
team.bio: A Certified Public Accountant and shareholder with over 20 years of experience providing strategic financial guidance to privately held businesses and entrepreneurs. He is licensed in Texas and is an active member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, the Texas Society of Certified Public Accountants and the Southeast Texas CPA Society. He earned his Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting from Texas State University in 1998, followed by a Master of Accountancy in 2000. He has a strong focus on companies in the home building industry, and his areas of expertise include business and personal tax preparation, tax planning, cash flow management, financial statement analysis and succession planning. He has also guided clients through venture capital funding, mergers and acquisitions and budget optimization.

team.name: Lori Hastings
team.bio: A Partner specializing in tax, financial statement preparation and payroll services. Known for her approachable nature and commitment to client success, she helps individuals and businesses navigate financial challenges with clarity and confidence. She earned her Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting from Lamar University.

team.name: Roger Croley, CPA
team.bio: A shareholder with over 20 years of experience helping clients with their financial and business needs, with an emphasis in audit, review and compilations. He is also well-versed in preparing both business and personal tax returns. He started his career in industry accounting for a publicly traded company, and he is licensed in the state of Texas and a member of the Texas Society of Certified Public Accountants.

team.name: Judy Lehner
team.bio: Office Manager, where she keeps the office running smoothly and handles key responsibilities such as filing tax returns, managing billings and overseeing franchise tax submissions. She joined the firm in 2017 and has over eight years of experience in the accounting environment, after 34 years in public education, and she holds both a bachelor's and a master's degree in education.

team.name: Tamra Basye
team.bio: Brings four years of experience in client communications, workflow processes, document organization and schedule coordination, and makes sure every client receives personalized attention and efficient service. She holds a bachelor's degree in technology with an emphasis on Business Education from the University of Houston, and retired from education after 28 years of teaching.

team.name: Linda Bahnsen
team.role: Accounting Services Manager / Senior Tax Associate
team.bio: Specializes in financial reporting and process improvements, with thirty years across private accounting, corporate manufacturing accounting, inventory management and purchasing management. She graduated from Lamar University in 1995 with a B.B.A. in Accounting and is working on an Enrolled Agent certificate through the IRS.

team.name: Jessica Kline
team.bio: A Senior Accountant with over 12 years of experience turning complex financial data into clear, actionable insights, from preparing accurate reports and ensuring compliance to streamlining processes for greater efficiency.

team.name: Christy Simmons
team.bio: With over 15 years of accounting experience, Christy has strong expertise in bookkeeping, payroll, payroll reporting and financial organization, and in managing day-to-day financial operations. She works with individuals, small businesses and corporate clients.

team.name: Darlene Calfee
team.bio: Brings over thirty years of accounting experience spanning banking and financial institutions, private and public corporations and non-profit organizations, having served as a mortgage accounting specialist, an office manager and an administrative manager.

team.name: Weston Hodge
team.bio: The first point of contact for several clients, overseeing document control and front office operations so that each client's visit and enquiry goes smoothly from start to finish. He brings six years of experience working with the public, holds a bachelor's degree in computer science from the University of Houston, and spent several years as a mathematics teacher and a licensed life insurance agent.
